title: Q3 Alignment: Hosted API Product Threads & Model Catalog Dependency Heatmap
creator: Aisha Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Q3 Execution
description:
Purpose: Create an execution-ready Q3 plan that aligns Hosted API product themes with the model catalog roadmap via a dependency heatmap and execution threads. Goal is to produce a single source of truth for owners, cross-team handoffs, and risk mitigations so we can commit to release windows and canary schedules.

Scope:
- Inventory model onboarding and deprecation events that affect hosted endpoints (latency/compatibility).
- Map platform work (runtime kernel updates, batching changes, KV cache improvements) to product releases that require compatibility guarantees.
- Identify top-3 cross-team blocking dependencies and produce mitigation plans.
- Produce a visual heatmap and a prioritized execution thread list for PM+ENG leads.

Why now: Q3 has overlapping efforts (model rotation, pricing experiment, caching pilot). Without a consolidated dependency view teams will over-commit and risk canary regressions or customer-facing outages. This ticket converts planning ambiguity into clear owners and targeted checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: A heatmap (confluence link) that shows all model catalog events vs Hosted API release windows with dependency severity annotations
A runbook listing top-3 blockers with owners and rollback/fallback strategies
A prioritized thread list with milestones, engineering effort estimates, and canary gating criteria
Stakeholder sign-off (PM, Eng Leads, SRE) recorded in the ticket comments

risks: Kernel update regressions causing increased latency on legacy GPUs
Model architecture changes that invalidate existing quantized runtimes
Insufficient test coverage for cross-region routing fallbacks leading to traffic blackholes during rollout
mitigations: Limit initial canary to 5% traffic and expand based on latency/regression telemetry
Prepare pre-built quantized variants for affected models to use as automatic fallbacks
Add a smoke-test that validates routing and KV cache integrity before canary promotion
